title: Handheld mixer operating in a bowl
visual_facts: A blue handheld mixing device is held vertically above a metal bowl containing a brown wet mixture.
A long metal shaft extends from the device into the bowl.
The digital display on the device reads 0220.
Several cylindrical sample containers and chunks of material are arranged on the workbench behind it.
A computer monitor and other laboratory items are visible in the background.
spatial_relations: The mixing shaft extends from the device into the bowl at the bottom center.
Sample containers are arranged behind the bowl on the workbench.
uncertainties: The mixture's composition and the purpose of the mixing operation are unknown.
